notes: Download URLs are direct GitHub ZIP archives where practical.
Some projects are better consumed from tagged releases; others are branch archives because no current release asset was obvious.
The list includes the power/renewable libraries discussed plus additional open-source Modelica energy-system libraries that are downloadable.

libraries.name: ModelicaStandardLibrary-4.1.0
libraries.short_description: Official Modelica Standard Library (MSL) release archive.

libraries.name: PowerSystems
libraries.short_description: General electrical power-system library for transient and steady-state AC/DC simulations; useful as a broad grid-modelling base.

libraries.name: WindPowerPlants
libraries.short_description: Focused wind-power-plant library with wind turbines, generators, pitch control, and an electrical interface to connect to grid models.

libraries.name: PhotoVoltaics
libraries.short_description: Photovoltaic cells, modules, plants, irradiance models, converters, MPPT, and simple battery models; probably one of the easiest PV starting points.

libraries.name: PVSystems
libraries.short_description: PV-system and power-converter design library with PV arrays, storage, converters, transformers, grid elements, and converter-control blocks.

libraries.name: MoSDH
libraries.short_description: Solar and geothermal district-heating systems with seasonal storage, including pit, borehole, and tank storage models.

libraries.name: OpenIPSL
libraries.short_description: Power-system dynamic-analysis library for phasor time-domain simulations; serious grid/stability tool, but not the easiest onboarding target.

libraries.name: OpenModelica_Microgrids
libraries.short_description: Small OpenModelica-oriented library for three-phase AC microgrids and control-structure experiments.

libraries.name: PowerGrids
libraries.short_description: Declarative electro-mechanical power-generation and transmission-system library using phasor approximation.

libraries.name: ModPowerSystems
libraries.short_description: Power-system components across static phasors, dynamic phasors, and electromagnetic-transient modelling.

libraries.name: ObjectStab
libraries.short_description: Voltage and transient-stability study library with generators, lines, transformers, loads, buses, compensation devices, and faults.

libraries.name: SolarTherm
libraries.short_description: Concentrating solar-thermal power/fuel station performance simulation and optimization using Modelica plus helper tooling.

libraries.name: Soltermica
libraries.short_description: Low-temperature solar-thermal systems for solar water heating, collectors, tanks, boilers, heat exchangers, and climatic conditions.

libraries.name: Spot
libraries.short_description: Archived predecessor-style power-system library for transient and steady-state modelling; useful historically, but not ideal for new work.

libraries.name: Modelica Buildings Library
libraries.short_description: Large open-source building energy/control library with HVAC, district energy, storage, controls, heat transfer, airflow, demand response, and AC/DC electrical systems.

libraries.name: AixLib
libraries.short_description: Building-performance simulation library for HVAC systems and high- and reduced-order building models; part of the IBPSA ecosystem.

libraries.name: Modelica IBPSA Library
libraries.short_description: Core library of best-practice models for building and community energy/control systems; mainly used as a base for Buildings, AixLib, IDEAS, etc.

libraries.name: IDEAS
libraries.short_description: Integrated District Energy Assessment Simulations library for simultaneous transient simulation of thermal and electrical energy systems at building and district level.

libraries.name: BuildSysPro
libraries.short_description: EDF open-source Modelica library for buildings, districts, and energy-systems modelling.

libraries.name: ClaRa
libraries.short_description: Open-source dynamic simulation library for power plants and other energy systems, focused on thermal hydraulics plus instrumentation and control.

libraries.name: ThermoPower
libraries.short_description: Open-source library for dynamic modelling of thermal power plants and energy-conversion systems, including solar direct steam and organic Rankine applications.

libraries.name: TRANSFORM
libraries.short_description: ORNL Modelica library for transient simulation of reconfigurable thermal-hydraulic energy systems and other multiphysics systems; Dymola-oriented and beta.

libraries.name: BEEAM
libraries.short_description: Building Electrical Efficiency Analysis Model for building electrical distribution efficiency using harmonic power flow, including AC, DC, hybrid networks, and converter losses.

libraries.name: DroneLibrary
libraries.short_description: Multi-domain UAV/drone library with quadcopter dynamics, electrical subsystems, control models, and 3D/FMI workflows.

libraries.name: RotorAeroLib
libraries.short_description: Rotorcraft-focused aerodynamics and stability library with quadcopter example models useful for UAV development.
